stories.title: Stronger ambient pre-filter: short transcript, non-Ukrainian, declarative-no-question
stories.evidence: src/decider.py adds _is_mostly_non_ukrainian() (Cyrillic<30% threshold with _CYRILLIC_RE/_LATIN_RE), _looks_like_question() (?-suffix or UA_QUESTION_WORD_PATTERN), and extends is_quick_nothing() with explicit rule ordering RULE 0-5. RULE 0 wake-word bypass runs first so 'heare status' passes despite non-Ukrainian rule. 11 new tests added to test_decider.py. 7 existing state-machine tests updated to use wake-word prefix ('Гава, ...') so they bypass the new filters (unrelated to state-machine coverage). Full suite: 219 tests pass, lint clean.
stories.rationale: The biggest immediate win for Groq STT pressure. Extends is_quick_nothing in src/decider.py to filter out 50-65% of ambient-mode transcripts that clearly aren't addressed to Heare. Wake-word check must run FIRST (RULE 0) so 'heare status' (100% Latin) still passes through despite the non-Ukrainian rule. Critic v2 finding #2 fixed via explicit rule ordering.
acceptanceCriteria: src/decider.py adds _is_mostly_non_ukrainian(text) that returns True when Cyrillic characters < 30% of alpha chars
src/decider.py adds _looks_like_question(text) that returns True when text ends with '?' OR contains Ukrainian question words (чи|як|що|коли|чому|хто|де|навіщо|скільки) as word-boundary matches

src/decider.py is_quick_nothing() filter ordering is explicit: RULE 0 = wake-word bypass (already exists lines 91-93), RULE 1 = focus mode, RULE 2 = other-person, RULE 3 (NEW) = short transcript in ambient (<3 words), RULE 4 (NEW) = non-Ukrainian in ambient, RULE 5 (NEW) = declarative-no-question in ambient
Wake-word ALWAYS bypasses RULES 3-5 even if transcript is short or English

stories.title: Tighten prompt reply length + force strict key order in output schema
stories.evidence: prompts/decider.txt rewritten with 'MAX 8 words' reply constraint, 'MAX 5 words' intent constraint, and 'FIELD ORDER IS STRICT' section declaring 't' must be first key and 'r' must immediately follow in speak responses. Added 'Be terse. Short replies feel more natural in voice.' guidance. Two new tests in test_context.py: test_decider_prompt_has_length_constraints and test_decider_prompt_mandates_strict_key_order. Updated test_render_real_decider_template assertions to check for the new schema format. 221 tests pass, lint clean.
stories.rationale: Prompt-only change that reduces output tokens (30-50 → 10-15) and forces the JSON output to emit 't' before 'r', which is a prerequisite for any future streaming parser (B3). No behavioral test against live LLM is required for ralph — static text-assertion on the prompt file is sufficient; actual model compliance verification is a post-deploy manual check (documented in the plan's B2 section).

stories.title: Speculative context build on UserStartedSpeakingFrame (with prereq frame-routing verification)
stories.evidence: Frame routing verification: UserStartedSpeakingFrame is a SystemFrame in Pipecat (verified via `cls.__mro__`), same class as BotStartedSpeakingFrame which already reaches DeciderProcessor. SystemFrames are broadcast to all downstream processors. Outcome (a) confirmed. Implementation: _load_pipecat_base extended to import UserStartedSpeakingFrame + UserStoppedSpeakingFrame. DeciderProcessor gains _speculative_prompt, _speculative_ctx, _speculative_task, _speculative_started_at, _speculative_stale_after_seconds=5.0 fields. UserStartedSpeakingFrame handler spawns _build_speculative() async task that renders the prompt with the {transcript_or_heartbeat} placeholder still present. _handle_listening now calls _prompt_for_transcript which (a) awaits up to 200ms for in-flight speculation, (b) substitutes transcript via str.replace, (c) falls back to normal context build if no/stale speculation. Stale guard at 5 seconds. 5 new tests verify: speculation built on frame, reused in handle_listening (context_builder.build NOT called a second time), cleared after use, fallback works with no prior speculation, stale speculation triggers fallback. 226 tests pass, lint clean.
stories.rationale: Pre-renders the decider prompt context while the user is still speaking, so when the final transcript arrives we only need to plug it in. Critic v2 finding #1 fixed via explicit prereq verification step with three outcome branches. If UserStartedSpeakingFrame doesn't reach DeciderProcessor and no upstream observer can be wired, the story DESCOPES cleanly with evidence logged in progress.txt.
